method: Twelve serial fresh-process trials, fixed 0.025s canonical step, no observers or profiler; all other simulation/test workers stopped. One complete matched R3 SS1 before/after pair plus five matched 120s SW2 policy windows. Before uses pristine PR180 and the same final frozen native inputs. No replication or statistical confidence interval; full workload and football history differ, so ratios do not isolate marginal function cost. RSS sampled every 8000 ticks is not an allocation peak.
